neutral.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: polished Japanese fantasy RPG dialogue standing portrait. ONE adult character, neutral attentive expression, gently dimensional anime painting with fine clean linework, soft warm frontal light, intricate believable clothing, the same visual finish as the female magician style reference. Portrait 1024x1536. Centered knee-up composition, full head and hands, shoulders level, relaxed front-facing standing pose. Character occupies about 88% height, 5% transparent margins, no cropping of hair or key props. Real transparent alpha background: absolutely no backdrop, dark vignette, glow, floor shadow, border, checkerboard artwork, letters or watermark. Draw anatomically coherent hands, exactly two arms, five fingers per visible hand. Produce one portrait only, not a sheet.
Subject: Serin, adult female alchemist in her late twenties, shoulder-length deep teal hair, amber eyes, subtle round alchemical goggles resting on her head, intelligent composed demeanor. Cream blouse, muted teal and brown fitted travel coat, leather apron-like waist panel and tool belt, neat small alchemy tools and corked teal glass potion bottles. Hold one translucent turquoise reagent bottle naturally near the hip, other hand relaxed. Refined fantasy chemist, not modern lab coat. Reference is STYLE ONLY; new teal-haired character, not the silver-haired mage.
Background constraint: only the character silhouette may have opacity. All surrounding pixels MUST be alpha=0. No colored haze, gradient, blurred studio backdrop or glow behind the head or hands.
